about: Fixed before any code that meets them (SANDBOX_INSTRUMENTS.md, "Barycenter, frame and what pulls on what"). A criterion that fails is reported with its numbers; no bound here is moved, widened or made conditional after a result.
G: both scenes set gravitational_constant 1 (the scenario's own value); the app's default world uses 2 and the integrator's bare default is 1
separation: the distance between the two stars at the moment judged

a.what: the marker's point against an independent mass-weighted mean (plain sums in the test, not barycenterOf), for the pair (a selected star and its primary) and for the system (barycenterBodies())
a.times: start, then every quarter of the binary period, five in all

b.what: largest distance of the two stars' centre of mass from its starting place over ten periods of the pair
b.stop: pairwise forces from one snapshot conserve momentum to rounding; a larger drift is an engine or build defect, recorded for the gravity-rule and black-hole work, never absorbed by widening

c.what: |sum m r'| / sum m over the bodies the barycentric frame averages, r' = r minus the frame's origin

identity.what: every coordinate of every body after 500 steps of each scene at 60 frames a second, before and after the source rule moved into one pure function; and the world-construction golden
identity.bound: bit for bit (Object.is on every coordinate); e2e/golden/world-construction.json unchanged

statement.what: the classes the statement says pull against the kinds present in cachedMajorSources, every kind present, under each of the four combinations of mutual_gravity and star_only_gravity
